project.title: CivicConnect – Smart Civic Complaint Management System with IBM Db2
project.short_description: A full-stack municipal grievance platform where citizens report infrastructure issues and IBM Db2 powers complaint persistence, audit trails, analytics, and AI-assisted department routing via LangChain + IBM watsonx.ai.

features_used: Relational Tables (COMPLAINTS, DEPARTMENTS, COMPLAINT_UPDATES, NOTIFICATIONS, CITIZEN_FEEDBACK, COMPLAINT_ANALYTICS)
CLOB Storage for complaint descriptions and AI summaries
Indexed queries on CATEGORY, STATUS, DEPARTMENT_NAME for dashboard filtering
Aggregation queries (COUNT, AVG, SUM) for analytics dashboard
Audit trail writes on every status transition
Firestore → Db2 sync pipeline for historical data migration
